motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the outermost edge of the blue-white runes on the stone changes: a few pixels along that edge shift very slightly in brightness and shift straight back. The blue-white runes on the stone is fully visible and exactly as easy to read in every single frame, including the last -- it never fades, never dims, never vanishes and is never swallowed by glare. Its inside stays exactly the blue-white it is in the first frame and never washes out into a plain bright blur. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.
